visual_contract.thumbnail_rule: 626x880 and 426x600 sources use 320px-wide optimized thumbnails; sources already at 313px or 213px keep byte-identical full and thumbnail files.
visual_contract.visual_style: Finished in-game character cards with a complete action/environment scene, deliberate face/body framing, readable name and rarity, and transparent ornate outer corners.
visual_contract.edge_treatment: No opaque rectangular matte around the irregular frame. Accepted sources preserve transparency at the outer corners.
visual_contract.background_treatment: Scene art or a character-specific environment with depth; plain low-rarity patterned fields are not accepted for new replacements.
visual_contract.quality: Sharp at the gallery render size, authentic, free of watermarks and unrelated variants, and losslessly prepared when no resize is needed.

priority_checked: Local decrypted official game character, background, rectangle, icon, and name assets
Official Kingdom Ran news pages and CDN overview images
Official site sitemap covering 5,902 info URLs
Exact-character preserved database pages for identity and rejection review
rejected_source_classes: RGB renditions with flattened black corners
Static low-rarity portraits on plain patterned fields
Raw transparent character layers that would require an invented composite

visual_review.result: Yugi and Domon match adjacent accepted Qin cards without black edge artifacts or responsive overflow. Unresolved characters retain the existing icon/initial fallback presentation.

validation.source_validation: PASS: 209/209 characters, 661/661 CW skills, 10/10 role-skill rows
validation.build_prerender_seo: PASS: 132 modules, 1,149 route documents plus 404.html, 936 canonical URLs
validation.browser: PASS: 80 Chromium cases across EN/JA/AR/FR, including banner alpha, 390/820/1440 layout, and fallback recovery
